purpose: Define explicit authorized declassification/sanitization operations as the only mechanism allowed to lower governed classification/taint on derived data.

topics.name: DWH Declassification Boundary
topics.purpose: Define explicit authorized declassification/sanitization operations as the only mechanism allowed to lower governed classification/taint on derived data.

semantics.operation_rule: Declassification is an explicit canonical operation/policy decision.
semantics.authority_rule: Lowering classification requires explicit authority independent from ordinary read/transform rights.
semantics.evidence_rule: Operation records source classification, target classification, method/rule, actor, reason/policy and output refs.
semantics.sanitization_rule: Sanitization/anonymization claims are tied to an explicit method/profile/version.
semantics.nonimplicit_rule: Aggregation, formatting, serialization or transport never implicitly declassifies data.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed/unsupported declassification leaves original classification in force.
semantics.trace_rule: Declassified output retains provenance to original restricted sources and declassification evidence.

invariants.rule: Derived DWH data retains explicit source lineage, transformation provenance and applicable classification/taint state; transformations never silently erase origin or governance metadata.

references.purpose: Only explicit declassification may lower propagated classification.

prose.summary: Define explicit authorized declassification/sanitization operations as the only mechanism allowed to lower governed classification/taint on derived data.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH schema, provenance, AccessCore and remote-data contracts.
